players.name: Arden Key
players.comment: Key (hamstring) was activated from injured reserve Saturday and does not carry an injury designation into Sunday's game against the Dolphins.

players.name: CJ Allen
players.comment: Allen recorded 10 tackles (three solo) and a pass breakup in Sunday's 27-23 loss to the Cowboys.

players.name: Bryce Boettcher
players.comment: Boettcher recorded 12 tackles (four solo) in Sunday's 27-23 loss to the Cowboys.

players.name: A.J. Haulcy
players.comment: Haulcy (ankle) was a full participant at Thursday's practice.

players.name: Justin Walley
players.comment: Walley (knee) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice.

players.name: Laquon Treadwell
players.comment: Treadwell logged 52 of the Colts' 64 snaps and was held without a reception on one target in Sunday's 27-23 loss to the Cowboys.

players.name: Ashton Dulin
players.comment: Head coach Shane Steichen said that Dulin will be one of the Colts receivers tasked with absorbing the snaps vacated by Keenan Allen, who was traded to the 49ers on Tuesday, Jake Arthur of Roundtable.io reports.

players.name: Anthony Gould
players.comment: Colts coach Shane Steichen said Wednesday that Gould is in line to step into the slot role previously held by Josh Downs, Stephen Holder of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Tyler Warren
players.comment: Warren may see more targets after the Colts traded wideouts Josh Downs and Keenan Allen on Tuesday, Chris Bumbaca of ColtsWire reports.

players.name: Jonathan Taylor
players.comment: The Colts informed Taylor that he won't be traded before Tuesday's deadline, Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.

players.name: Jordyn Brooks
players.comment: Brooks recorded 12 tackles (four solo) during Sunday's 19-9 loss versus the Lions.

players.name: Jacob Rodriguez
players.comment: Rodriguez recorded 10 tackles (seven solo) including 1.0 sacks during Sunday's 19-9 loss versus the Lions.

players.name: Zane Gonzalez
players.comment: The Dolphins signed Gonzalez off the practice squad to the active roster Saturday.

players.name: Chris Bell
players.comment: Bell (knee) is inactive for Sunday's Week 10 matchup against the Colts.

players.name: Kyle McCord
players.comment: McCord will step in as the Dolphins' starting quarterback beginning with Sunday's game at Indianapolis after Miami placed Malik Willis (core) on injured reserve Tuesday, Cameron Wolfe of NFL Network reports.

players.name: Greg Dulcich
players.comment: Dulcich caught two of four targets for 14 yards in Sunday's 19-9 loss to the Lions.
